name: woocommerce/tax-rate-create
label: Create tax rate
description: Add a tax rate to a tax class. Takes the fields that tax-rates-query returns, so check there first that no rate already covers the location.

rate.description: Percentage as a decimal string, such as "19" or "7.25".

country.description: Two-letter country code, or empty for every country.

state.description: State code such as CA, or empty for every state. For a country with no state list, the state as customers enter it.

postcodes.description: Postcodes the rate is limited to. Takes ranges such as 10000...19999 and wildcards such as 10*. Empty for every postcode.

cities.description: Cities the rate is limited to. Empty for every city.

name.description: Name shown on the cart, checkout and invoices. Empty saves the name Tax.

priority.description: Only one matching rate per priority applies. Use a different priority to stack rates.

compound.description: Whether the rate applies on top of the other taxes.

shipping.description: Whether the rate also applies to shipping.

class.description: Tax class slug; standard for the standard rates.

shipping.description: Whether the rate also applies to shipping.
